messages:
lucas: Heads up — CI perf job flagged a KV cache stall regression on the kernel-selector path after last night's merge. P99 gen latency jumped from ~110ms to ~380ms. CI run: https://ci.redwood/internal/runs/6789 :warning:
chen: On it. I reproduced a smaller spike locally. perf flame shows a long spin in kv_cache::lookup_spinlock around the prefetch code path.
sara: Can we bisect to a commit? which PRs landed in that window?
mike: The obvious candidates are PR#2486 (kernel routing tweaks) and PR#2491 (kvcache prefetch + lock change). 2491 was merged ~02:15 UTC.
emma: 2491 was my change — I added a per-batch speculative prefetch and switched to a try_lock fallback. It passed unit tests but maybe under high concurrency it toggles to a spin path.
lucas: Let's run an automated bisect in CI focusing on p99 for gen latency. mike, can you kick the bisect harness?
mike: kicked off: `./scripts/ci_bisect.sh --range abc123..def456 --metric p99 --job perf/e2e-kv`
deploy-bot: Job perf/e2e-kv started (run id 6790).
chen: While bisect runs, I pushed a micro-profiler snapshot to the thread. snippet:
```text
# top hotspots (ms)
kv_cache::lookup_spinlock  1420ms (45%)
kernel::select_best_kernel  430ms (13%)
batch_dispatcher::wait     310ms (9%)
```
sara: If bisect points to 2491, pause the canary. I'm putting the rollout on hold now: `console: rollout/v1.9.2 -> PAUSED` :no_entry_sign:
mike: bisect completed — culprit commit is def234 which maps to PR#2491. Confirmed on three CI seeds.
emma: ack. I'll prepare a hotpatch revert/cherry-pick. I'll also add a short cooldown to the lock path and a test for concurrent prefetch.
lucas: Good. Please include a perf regression unit that simulates 200 concurrent small sequences so we don't regress again.
emma: PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infra/pull/2510 — title: "hotpatch(release/v1.9.2): revert speculative prefetch + lock cooldown". Running CI now.
ops-bot: Deploy cooldown enforced for release/v1.9.2 across auto-rollouts.
mike: CI perf for PR#2510 shows P99 back to ~120ms on canary nodes (3 runs). Still running dedicated verification.
sara: Running dedicated smoke tests with 1k concurrent streams now. will post numbers in ~10m.
lucas: Also add a metric for kv_lock_hold_ns and eviction_stall_count so we can alert on regressions automatically.
chen: noted — I'll add counters and a small tracing span in kv_lookup for next PR.
sara: Dedicated smoke: p95=95ms p99=140ms, tail looks fine compared to baseline. Approving hotpatch for backport and merge. :white_check_mark:
deploy-bot: Rollout resumed: release/v1.9.2 canary -> 10% -> holding for manual verify.
mike: I'll cherry-pick the hotpatch to master and create backport PR into release branch after merge.
lucas: Thanks all. Summary: revert spec prefetch, add lock cooldown, add perf counters, run canary/dedicated validation. Follow-up: file an issue to rework batching heuristics instead of speculative prefetch.
chen: Filed issue #4367: "kvcache: redesign prefetch to avoid lock contention under high batch concurrency".
lucas: Good work — I'll write a short incident note and link the PRs.
lucas: (later) Postmortem TODO: include timeline, perf graphs, and the canary hold decision point.
